To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the routine use of FIB micro‐manufacturing to produce aperture probes with controllable sizes and shapes is demonstrated, which is a critical advance for the development of high‐resolution near‐field optical microscopy.
the near‐field optical probes are fabricated by using a focused ion beam to machine the silicon nitride cantilvered atomic force microscopy probe tips.
we have developed a new method of fabricating near‐field scanning probe tips with sub‐100 nm aperture sizes using focussed ion beam machining.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the fabrication and characterization of near‐field optical probes by FIB micro‐maching.
the fabrication of high‐resolution aperture probes for NSOM applications using FIB machining techniques.
the development and application of the FIB micro‐maching technique in the fabrication of high performance aperture probes for the near‐field scanning microscope.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of the FIB micro‐milling technique is a reliable, robust, versatile, and reproducible method to fabricate high resolution NSOM aperture probe tips.
FIB is an effective tool to fabricate NSOM aperture probes with controllable sizes and shapes.
FIB is an ideal tool to fabricate high‐performance NSOM probes from commercial AFM probes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the FIB side milling method is more suitable for the silicon nitride cantilivered probes while the FIB head drilling method is more suitable when the probes are coated with metal.
FIB is an excellent tool to micro‐machine aperture probes from the silicon nitride cantilvered AFM tips.
FIB is an ideal tool for the routine micro‐machining of NSOM aperture probes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
FIB is a powerful tool for micro‐machining aperture probes for NSOM.
the FIB‐micro machining approach is a very effective way of fabricating NSOM aperture tips.
the commercial silicon nitrides cantilevers can be used as a platform for the fabrication of NSOM probes by using FIB micro‐milling.
